title: Piri piri lemon marinade
preamble:
1 cup lemon juice

3/4 cup olive oil

1/4 cup minced garlic

2 tablespoons hot chili flakes

2 teaspoons dried oregano
method: In a 1-quart glass measure or a bowl, mix lemon juice, olive oil, garlic, chili flakes, oregano, thyme, cumin, and salt.
details: Category: Condiments, Jams, Preserves, Pickles and Sauces
